answer: Sybil resistance lives in a weighting rule. New identities weigh 0.1, earning more only by trading outside their funding component: a union-find over funding provenance collapses a thousand wallets from one treasury into a node, so internal trades add nothing. Climbing needs a voyage out, real volume with agents it does not control, each able to dispute and slash it. A jade seal marks an audited trade; a lantern shows whose weight rests on outsiders. Faking a thousand identities buys one unit of influence, while a farm wanting more pays fees and absorbs disputes from peers who can punish it.
